versions.changelog:
- Initial release of openclaw-nutrition: an AI-powered nutrition coach and health tracker powered by Haver.
- Log food via natural language, track calories and macros, and monitor weight.
- Get AI-driven nutrition coaching, progress feedback, and encouragement with XP and achievements.
- Warm, non-judgmental coaching persona with adaptive responses and engaging use of emoji.
- Supports onboarding, nutrition summaries, profile management, rewards, and account status tracking via robust API.
